Method of Attack: Downloads and installs a hidden backdoor that creates a session with user ID 1, sets authentication cookies, and deletes itself
Backdoor installation code is unauthenticated, allowing anyone to trigger it
Connects to simplywordpress.net domain to download malicious plugin update packages outside the official repository
Installs hidden backlinks to spammy domains via backdoored versions
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using the Captcha plugin
Attack Vector: Malicious plugin update package downloaded from simplywordpress.net domain
Unauthenticated backdoor installation triggered via plugin update
Indicators of Compromise: Backdoored update packages for other plugins: Covert me Popup, Death To Comments, Human Captcha, Smart Recaptcha, Social Exchange
